notes: Total War: Warhammer 3 Immortal Empires campaign relief, near-top-down. Sharpest relief detail we have for its arc (Naggaroth -> Ulthuan -> Old World -> Southlands -> Dark Lands). tww3_map_stitched.paint is the editable master; this .png is the consumed flat artifact. Canvas coordinates and footprint were shifted in S2 to follow the refined config/canvas_frame.ANCHORS. LAYER PRECEDENCE MATTERS HERE: this is a 3-D game render placed by five hand-picked points, so it takes high precedence for *relief* (60) and deliberately near-lowest for *coastline* (10). It contributes zero-mean high-frequency detail on land inside its footprint and is never allowed to move a shoreline that the Terraqueous NE-II fit pins to sub-pixel accuracy - a misregistered coast would be a permanent, hard-to-spot error baked into every later phase. The TW3 UI arrows (right edge) and top-right out-of-bounds fog are excluded by the crop plus the land mask; Ulthuan's ring is the strongest cross-source anchor. MIGRATED to the Miller canvas frame (migrate_frame_coords.py, 2026-08-04). Control points and footprint were carried through lon/lat, not re-picked: canvas px -> old plate carree -> lon/lat -> Miller. The source-side picks are untouched, so the features they name are unchanged.
